justification: SELINA: Obviously I noticed Waddle's a zero before anyone else in this building did — you don't get to be "Out" on MY lineup card, sweetie, so DK Metcalf is in, and don't act surprised when he outscores whatever Denver was going to give me. GARY: (for the record — Waddle's tagged Out and Odunze's Bears have a bye this week, so I slid in Metcalf for Waddle and Shakir for Odunze in FLEX, both the healthiest, highest-graded names sitting on our bench; Josh Allen, Charbonnet, Braelon Allen, Lamb, Kelce and the Steelers D all stay exactly where the sheet already had them, because none of it needed fixing except the two zeros.) SELINA: Leon's out there bragging about 7-2 like Burrow invented football — he hasn't beaten a real lineup yet, and today he finds out what "optimal and dull" actually does to a scoreboard.
